28 entries and 64 items of one made-up project; 34 judged queries, each run the way `loom log --grep` runs it (`--limit 30`). **recall@5**: the share of a query's relevant items among the first 5 shown. **MRR**: the mean of 1 / the position of the first relevant item (0 when none is shown). **empty**: the share of queries shown nothing. Each category isolates one kind of miss, so the `all` row (an average over queries, not over categories) depends on the mix: it compares two runs, it does not estimate real-world quality.
